markets.name: Clatskanie Farmers Market
markets.about: Nestled in a small rural town along the banks of the Clatskanie River, the Clatskanie Farmers Market is a great place to stop on the way to the coast. The small market offers a rich array of local artisans, crafters, and small scale food producers who grow in the fertile soil of
